gloss: to improve; to make progress; to get better at

definitions.gloss: to improve; to make progress; to get better at
definitions.explanation: To become more skilled or proficient at something through practice or experience. Used for skills, abilities, and performance.

examples.japanese: {日本語|にほんご}が{上達|じょうたつ}した。
{毎日|まいにち}{練習|れんしゅう}すれば、{必|かなら}ず{上達|じょうたつ}する。
examples.english: If you practice every day, you'll definitely improve.

examples.japanese: ピアノを{始|はじ}めて{三年|さんねん}になるが、なかなか{上達|じょうたつ}しなくて{悩|なや}んでいる。
examples.english: It's been three years since I started piano, but I'm frustrated because I'm not improving much.

notes:
USAGE:
The subject is typically a skill or ability rather than a person. You say 「{日本語|にほんご}が{上達|じょうたつ}する」 (Japanese improves) rather than 「{私|わたし}が{上達|じょうたつ}する」 (I improve), though the latter is also grammatically possible.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {語学|ごがく}が{上達|じょうたつ}する (language skills improve)
- {上達|じょうたつ}が{早|はや}い (improvement is fast)
- {上達|じょうたつ}の{秘訣|ひけつ} (secret to improvement)
- {腕|うで}が{上達|じょうたつ}する (one's skill improves)
- めきめき{上達|じょうたつ}する (improve rapidly)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {進歩|しんぽ}する: to advance, to progress — broader; can apply to technology, society, or personal skills
- {向上|こうじょう}する: to improve, to elevate — more formal; used for quality, standards, or overall levels
- {熟達|じゅくたつ}する: to master — implies reaching a high level of expertise
